summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves a file from the uploads folder by name. The change also makes the dev server listen on all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.problem: The download handler joins the request name parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any validation. A name like ../../etc/passwd or /etc/passwd escapes UPLOAD_DIR, because os.path.join drops the base for absolute paths.
findings.consequence: Any client can read every file the server process can read. This includes secrets, config files and source code.
findings.fix: Resolve the joined path and reject it unless it stays inside UPLOAD_DIR. Alternatively, serve the file through Flask send_from_directory, which applies safe_join.

findings.title: Interactive debugger enabled on a network-facing server
findings.problem: The change turns on debug mode, and the same line binds the server to all interfaces. Together they make the Werkzeug interactive debugger reachable from other hosts.
findings.consequence: A remote user who triggers an error can reach the debugger console. With the PIN, which the path traversal bug can help recover, that user can run arbitrary code.
findings.fix: Remove debug=True, or set it from an environment variable that is off by default.

findings.title: Default bind changed from localhost to all interfaces
findings.problem: The change moves the default bind address from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0. The dev server is now reachable from any network the host is on.
findings.consequence: Other machines can reach the development server and the new download endpoint. Before this change, only local clients could reach them.
findings.fix: Keep 127.0.0.1 as the default bind address. Let operators opt into a wider bind through configuration.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a new download handler with a 404 path and a file-serving path. No test file in the repository exercises either path.
findings.consequence: Regressions in path handling, including the traversal guard, would go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for a valid file, a missing file and a traversal attempt.
